links.comparator_used: A-line baseline: four institutional manuals ingested as-is, without restructuring
links.outcome: Retrieved chunk quality across five LLM-as-a-Judge metrics (including Faithfulness) in a proof-of-concept comparison
links.effect: A-line (594 chunks): median scores of 2.0 or below on all five metrics, with fewer than 20% of chunks scoring 4 or higher. B-line (6 chunks from one restructured section): perfect scores across all metrics.
links.tradeoff: Organizations must invest in preparing well-structured knowledge documents. The B-line was only a proof of concept (6 chunks, one document section) with no statistical comparison. Level 1 inter-rater agreement was only fair (Fleiss kappa 0.269).
links.quote: The B-line optimization achieved perfect scores across all metrics, demonstrating potential for improvement.

design_hint: knowledge document restructuring for RAG retrieval
